notes: Χάριν ἔχω is one rule 73 unit on the single English verb thank, headed on the noun the English verb realizes; the later μνείαν … ἔχω is the contrast and splits, the ASV spelling both elements out as remembrance and is.

The my of my remembrance was given to the article under rule 20's second arm and rule 76, σοῦ being already spent on of thee and in any case naming a different person; reading it as an added supplement remains defensible.
